reasoning: Large, dark brown to black necrotic lesions at leaflet margins on a tomato compound leaf, each surrounded by a prominent yellow/chlorotic halo. The lesion size, dark coloration, and yellow halo are characteristic of Early Blight (Alternaria solani). Late Blight is ruled out by the yellow (not gray/green) border and absence of white sporulation. Septoria and TSWV are ruled out by lesion size and pattern.
